map.text: SL Karta shows every bus, train and metro. Live, on one map.

lines.text: Tap a stop, and see every line running through it.

vehicle.text: Tap a departure, and follow it, stop by stop, all the way to yours.

favorites.text: Save the rides you take every day.

nearby.text: and see what's leaving right around you.

desktop.text: On your phone, or on the web.
